scope: Impact Severity Index is computed from the archived blend record; vulnerability factors are documented pilot-zone assumptions (see VULNERABILITY rationale fields)

zones.advisory: GREEN. bay of bengal east coast is forecast in the low-impact class. No special action beyond routine monitoring.
zones.vulnerability_rationale: Low-lying cyclone-exposed coastline (Odisha/Andhra); storm-surge and deltaic inundation history.

zones.advisory: GREEN. kerala western ghats is forecast in the low-impact class. No special action beyond routine monitoring.
zones.vulnerability_rationale: Steep Western Ghats slopes with high landslide susceptibility; 2018/2019 Wayanad-Idukki slope failures.

zones.advisory: GREEN. indo gangetic plains is forecast in the low-impact class. No special action beyond routine monitoring.
zones.vulnerability_rationale: Dense urban centres with constrained drainage (Patna/Kolkata waterlogging) over a large flood plain.

zones.vulnerability_rationale: Steep Western Ghats slopes with high landslide susceptibility; 2018/2019 Wayanad-Idukki slope failures.

zones.advisory: YELLOW ALERT. bay of bengal east coast is forecast in the moderate-impact class. Recommended action: monitor updates, brief local bodies, and prepare shelters and relief stocks.
zones.vulnerability_rationale: Low-lying cyclone-exposed coastline (Odisha/Andhra); storm-surge and deltaic inundation history.
